question: Which of the following is a major event in plants during day time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**O₂ release**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **major event in plants during the day is O₂ release.**
 
• This occurs during photosynthesis, where plants take in carbon dioxide (CO₂) and water (H₂O) 
 
• It **uses sunlight, to convert them into glucose and oxygen**.
 
• Oxygen (O₂) is **released as a byproduct into the atmosphere.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• During 24 hours there is a time when plants neither release O2 nor CO2. This is the time of Twilight__.
 
• Twilight is the period of time before sunrise and after sunset.
 
• The atmosphere is partially illuminated by the sun, being neither totally dark or completely lit.
 
• Plants release oxygen during the day in the presence of natural light through the process of photosynthesis.
 
• While at night, the plants uptake oxygen and release carbon dioxide, which is called respiration.
